<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="reviewed" xml:id="ex047032025-11-1011-17-00" ana="corpusmd:post_colophon">
         <milestone unit="section" n="Scribe colophon (5b1-5b2)"/>
             <pb n="5b"/><lb n="5b1"/> <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4411">dam pas bsngags pa'i gnas dpal snar thang gi dben gnas</rs> su <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3977">bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen snar thang pa bdun par byon pa</rs>'i phyag dpe las <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5788">btsun pa grags pa rgyal mtshan</rs> <lb n="5b2"/> gyis 'brug gi lo ma rgyu'i zla ba'i yar tshes bcu<note type="editorial">Date of writing: In the year of the dragon, on the tenth day of the ? moon</note> la bris so || 
             <abbr>bdag gzhan</abbr> <abbr>thams cad</abbr> smin cing grol bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol || bkra shis |
             <note type="gloss">2 zhus</note>
             </seg></TEI>
